title.narrative: Interfaith dialogue and ecumenical training and networking activities, MCC

description.narrative:
The grant is given to the organisation due to their application to the COVID-19 Emergency Pool (Nødpulje) in order for the organisation to continue their skills development activities in India. Due to COVID-19 restrictions, planned development activities are in risk of closure, which would negatively affect results.
Strategic objectives: Common platform of mutual respect, mutual acceptance, and mutual recognition upon diversity such as religion and Christian denominations will ensure the communal peace building in targeted areas.

To nurture the resource persons of interfaith dialogue for multiplication of interfaith dialogue knowledge and awareness in local areas.
To strengthen ecumenical networking among the different Christian denomination in the regional level.
To promote the ecumenical spirit for enhancement of inter and intra faith dialogue.
